Finley: adapting explanations
Finley likes noticing where another student gets stuck and finding a different example. Tutoring a younger pupil was more enjoyable than doing a task for them. Finley likes science and language subjects, is willing to study education, and wants a steady life with time for friends rather than a very high income goal.
Fictional development case. Includes shared scripted defaults.

More info · salary sources
Austin–Round Rock–San Marcos, Texas metro · 2026–2027 academic year. These figures show employee pay, not a business’s sales. Source years are preserved; future inflation and promotions are not added.
Austin ISD 2026–2027 new-hire base placement at 0–2 certified, 5, 10, and 20 credited years; 187-day contract. Excludes stipends and incentives. This is a current employer example, not a promise of future raises or an incumbent pay trajectory.
Figures hold purchasing power constant. No future inflation is added. Future labor-market conditions and personal outcomes can differ.
Entry means a first full-time qualified job after required preparation. Experience years begin there; education and apprenticeship years are separate.
2026–2027 Compensation Manual · New Hire Teacher/Librarian Pay Plan ↗
· Austin Independent School District · checked 2026-10-18 · 2026–2027 academic year New-hire placement by credited experience, 187-day base salary; the 0–2 certified row is used for entry. Incumbent PPfT/incentives and future raises are separate.
OEWS May 2025 · Austin metro ↗
· U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, via O*NET OnLine Local wage anchor; all experience ratios are Fieldguide assumptions.
How to use occupational wages ↗
· U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Wage variation guidance; does not publish experience-year estimates.
Entry and experienced wage definitions ↗
· Texas Workforce Commission Entry is the mean of the lowest-paid third; experienced is the mean of the upper-paid two-thirds. These groups are not years of experience.
Published experienced-wage anchor ↗
· Texas Workforce Commission Average of the upper-paid two-thirds; not measured pay at a particular experience year.
